name: player-reports
author: Takaro
description: Player reports: players type `report <player> <reason>` (or `report <reason>` for general issues) to open a numbered ticket. Staff online with REPORTS_RECEIVE get a PM, and an optional Discord channel gets an alert. Each ticket stores the reporter's and target's position and online status, plus the target's last chat lines. Staff use `reports`, `reportview <id>` and `reportclose <id> [note]`; the reporter is told when it is closed. Cooldown and max open reports stop spam.
summary: Players report griefers, cheaters or problems with one command. Each report becomes a numbered ticket with positions and recent chat attached. Online staff get a PM, an optional Discord alert fires, and staff list, view and close tickets in game. The reporter is told when their report is handled. Cooldown and an open-report limit stop spam.

cooldownSeconds.title: Cooldown (seconds)
cooldownSeconds.description: How long a player must wait between two reports. 0 = no cooldown.

maxOpenReportsPerPlayer.title: Max open reports per player
maxOpenReportsPerPlayer.description: A player cannot file a new report while this many of theirs are still open. 0 = no limit.

allowGeneralReports.title: Allow general reports
allowGeneralReports.description: Allow `report <reason>` without naming a player (bugs, stuck, general problems).

minReasonLength.title: Minimum reason length
minReasonLength.description: Shortest reason (in characters) that is accepted.

maxReasonLength.title: Maximum reason length
maxReasonLength.description: Longer reasons are cut to this many characters.

chatContextLines.title: Chat lines of the reported player
chatContextLines.description: How many recent chat lines of the reported player to attach to the ticket. 0 = off.

discordChannelId.title: Discord channel ID
discordChannelId.description: Optional. Discord channel ID for report alerts (needs the Takaro Discord bot in your server). Empty = off.

permissions.description: Gets an in-game PM when a player files a report.
Can list, view and close reports (reports, reportview, reportclose).

report.description: Report a player or a problem to staff
report.helpText: report <player> <reason> - report a player. report <reason> - report a general problem.

arguments.name: text
arguments.helpText: Player name followed by the reason, or just the reason

reports.helpText: Lists the newest open reports. Needs REPORTS_MANAGE.

reportview.description: Staff: show one report with its context
reportview.helpText: reportview <id> - shows reporter, target, positions, reason and chat context. Needs REPORTS_MANAGE.

reportclose.description: Staff: close a report, optionally with a note
reportclose.helpText: reportclose <id> [note] - closes the report and tells the reporter. Needs REPORTS_MANAGE.

deliver-notices.description: Tells reporters about reports that were closed while they were offline
